dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Princess Nevada arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. Her previous owner describes her as social and affectionate. While in care, Princess has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to retreat from handlers and begin seeking exit when they attempt to interact. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Princess Nevada
